class.name: NetwAccountProvider
class.brief_description: Proves one kind of player account to the server when the player joins.

method.name: _prove
method.description: Runs on the joining peer. Return a proof of the account that answers [param challenge], or [code]null[/code] when this player has none. It may [code]await[/code] or return a [NetwPromise]. [param session] is the session this peer is joining.

method.name: _verify
method.description: Runs on the server with what [method _prove] returned. Call [method NetwJoinRequest.add_account] for the account [param proof] proves and return [constant @GlobalScope.OK]. Any other [enum @GlobalScope.Error] refuses the join. It may [code]await[/code] or return a [NetwPromise].
